```{r load_standards}
#| include: false

# Load comprehensive regulatory standards
standards_file <- "data/raw/Permissible Limits of Heavy Metals.xlsx"

# WHO Standards (corrected from your actual file)
who_standards <- read_excel(standards_file, sheet = "WHO Drinking Water") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(!is.na(metal_ion) & !is.na(who_limit_mg_l_ppm)) %>%
  mutate(
    metal = case_when(
      metal_ion == "As" ~ "Arsenic",
      metal_ion == "Pb" ~ "Lead", 
      metal_ion == "Cd" ~ "Cadmium",
      metal_ion == "Hg" ~ "Mercury",
      TRUE ~ metal_ion
    ),
    who_limit_ug_l = as.numeric(who_limit_mg_l_ppm) * 1000,
    health_effects = effects
  ) %>%
  select(metal, who_limit_ug_l, health_effects)

# EPA Standards
epa_standards <- read_excel(standards_file, sheet = "Water (US EPA 1981)") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(!is.na(parameter)) %>%
  mutate(
    metal = case_when(
      parameter == "As" ~ "Arsenic",
      parameter == "Pb" ~ "Lead",
      parameter == "Cd" ~ "Cadmium", 
      parameter == "Hg" ~ "Mercury",
      TRUE ~ parameter
    ),
    epa_class_a_ug_l = as.numeric(class_a) * 1000,
    epa_class_b_ug_l = as.numeric(class_b) * 1000,
    epa_class_c_ug_l = as.numeric(class_c) * 1000,
    epa_class_d_ug_l = as.numeric(class_d) * 1000
  ) %>%
  select(metal, epa_class_a_ug_l, epa_class_b_ug_l, epa_class_c_ug_l, epa_class_d_ug_l)

# International comparison standards
intl_standards <- read_excel(standards_file, sheet = "Food, water, soil various stand") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(matrix == "Drinking water") %>%
  mutate(
    region = area_of_application,
    arsenic_ug_l = as.numeric(arsenic_as) * 1000,
    cadmium_ug_l = as.numeric(cadmium_cd) * 1000,
    mercury_ug_l = as.numeric(mercury_hg) * 1000,
    lead_ug_l = as.numeric(lead_pb) * 1000
  ) %>%
  select(region, arsenic_ug_l, cadmium_ug_l, mercury_ug_l, lead_ug_l)

# Enhanced USGS Sediment Standards
usgs_sediment <- read_excel(standards_file, sheet = "Sediments (USGS)") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(!is.na(substance)) %>%
  mutate(
    metal = case_when(
      substance == "As" ~ "Arsenic",
      substance == "Pb" ~ "Lead",
      substance == "Cd" ~ "Cadmium",
      substance == "Hg" ~ "Mercury",
      TRUE ~ substance
    )
  ) %>%
  select(metal, pel, sel, tet, erm, consensus_based_pec, unit)

# Create comprehensive standards comparison table
comprehensive_standards <- data.frame(
  Metal = c("Arsenic", "Lead", "Cadmium", "Mercury"),
  WHO_ug_L = c(50, 50, 3, 1),  # Corrected from standards file
  EPA_ClassA_ug_L = c(30, 50, 5, 1),
  EPA_ClassD_ug_L = c(100, 100, 5, 1),
  EU_ug_L = c(10, 1, 5, 10),
  International_ug_L = c(10, 10, 3, 1),
  USA_ug_L = c(10, 15, 5, 2)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Most_Restrictive = pmin(WHO_ug_L, EPA_ClassA_ug_L, EU_ug_L, International_ug_L),
    Most_Permissive = pmax(WHO_ug_L, EPA_ClassD_ug_L, EU_ug_L, USA_ug_L)
  )
```

```{r load_real_data}
#| include: false

# Clean, simple data loading function
load_water_data <- function() {
  years <- 2016:2024
  all_data <- list()
  
  cat("Loading water quality data...\n")
  
  for (year in years) {
    file_path <- paste0("data/processed/water_", year, "_clean.xlsx")
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      tryCatch({
        data <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = 1) %>%
          mutate(Year = year) %>%
          clean_names() %>%
          # Convert all columns to character first to avoid type conflicts
          mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
        
        cat("Year", year, "- Rows:", nrow(data), "\n")
        all_data[[as.character(year)]] <- data
        
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Error reading year", year, ":", e$message, "\n")
      })
    }
  }
  
  # Simple data combination with type conversion
  if (length(all_data) > 0) {
    combined_data <- bind_rows(all_data, .id = "source_year") %>%
      mutate(
        Year = as.numeric(source_year),
        station = estacion,
        
        # Direct assignment using exact column names from your data
        # Convert to numeric after combining to avoid type conflicts
        arsenic_total = as.numeric(arsenico_total_ug_l_as),
        lead_total = as.numeric(plomo_total_ug_l_pb),
        cadmium_total = as.numeric(cadmio_total_ug_l_cd),
        mercury_total = as.numeric(mercurio_total_ug_l_hg),
        
        # Convert coordinates to numeric
        lat_decimal = as.numeric(latitud_decimal),
        lon_decimal = as.numeric(longitud_decimal),
        
        # Date handling
        date = tryCatch(as.Date(fecha, format = "%d/%m/%Y"), error = function(e) as.Date(NA))
      ) %>%
      # Filter valid data
      filter(
        !is.na(station), 
        station != "",
        !station %in% c("NA", "NULL")
      ) %>%
      # Validate ranges
      filter(
        if_else(is.na(arsenic_total), TRUE, arsenic_total >= 0 & arsenic_total < 10000),
        if_else(is.na(lead_total), TRUE, lead_total >= 0 & lead_total < 100000),
        if_else(is.na(cadmium_total), TRUE, cadmium_total >= 0 & cadmium_total < 1000),
        if_else(is.na(mercury_total), TRUE, mercury_total >= 0 & mercury_total < 100)
      )
    
    cat("Combined data: ", nrow(combined_data), "rows\n")
    cat("Unique stations:", length(unique(combined_data$station)), "\n")
    
    # Show sample of metals data found
    metals_found <- combined_data %>%
      summarise(
        arsenic_samples = sum(!is.na(arsenic_total)),
        lead_samples = sum(!is.na(lead_total)),
        cadmium_samples = sum(!is.na(cadmium_total)),
        mercury_samples = sum(!is.na(mercury_total))
      )
    cat("Heavy metals data found:\n")
    print(metals_found)
    
    return(combined_data)
  } else {
    return(data.frame())
  }
}

# Simple sediment data loading with safe column checking
load_sediment_data <- function() {
  years <- 2016:2024
  all_sed_data <- list()
  
  cat("Loading sediment data...\n")
  
  for (year in years) {
    file_path <- paste0("data/processed/sed_", year, "_clean.xlsx")
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      tryCatch({
        data <- read_excel(file_path) %>%
          mutate(Year = year) %>%
          clean_names() %>%
          # Convert all to character first to avoid type conflicts
          mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
        
        cat("Sediment year", year, "- Rows:", nrow(data), "Columns:", paste(head(names(data), 10), collapse = ", "), "\n")
        all_sed_data[[as.character(year)]] <- data
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Error reading sediment", year, ":", e$message, "\n")
      })
    }
  }
  
  # Simple sediment combination with safe column handling
  if (length(all_sed_data) > 0) {
    # First combine the data
    combined_sed_data <- bind_rows(all_sed_data, .id = "source_year")
    
    # Check what columns are actually available
    cat("Sediment columns available:", paste(names(combined_sed_data), collapse = ", "), "\n")
    
    # Safely extract station and any available sediment metals
    combined_sed_data <- combined_sed_data %>%
      mutate(
        station = if("estacion" %in% names(.)) estacion else NA_character_
      )
    
    # Add metals columns one by one with safe checking
    if ("arsenico_mg_kg_fraccion_mg_kg_as" %in% names(combined_sed_data)) {
      combined_sed_data$arsenic_mg_kg <- as.numeric(combined_sed_data$arsenico_mg_kg_fraccion_mg_kg_as)
    } else {
      combined_sed_data$arsenic_mg_kg <- NA_real_
    }
    
    if ("plomo_mg_kg_fraccion_mg_kg_pb" %in% names(combined_sed_data)) {
      combined_sed_data$lead_mg_kg <- as.numeric(combined_sed_data$plomo_mg_kg_fraccion_mg_kg_pb)
    } else {
      combined_sed_data$lead_mg_kg <- NA_real_
    }
    
    if ("cadmio_mg_kg_fraccion_mg_kg_cd" %in% names(combined_sed_data)) {
      combined_sed_data$cadmium_mg_kg <- as.numeric(combined_sed_data$cadmio_mg_kg_fraccion_mg_kg_cd)
    } else {
      combined_sed_data$cadmium_mg_kg <- NA_real_
    }
    
    if ("mercurio_ug_kg_fraccion_ug_kg_hg" %in% names(combined_sed_data)) {
      combined_sed_data$mercury_ug_kg <- as.numeric(combined_sed_data$mercurio_ug_kg_fraccion_ug_kg_hg)
      combined_sed_data$mercury_mg_kg <- combined_sed_data$mercury_ug_kg / 1000  # Convert to mg/kg
    } else {
      combined_sed_data$mercury_ug_kg <- NA_real_
      combined_sed_data$mercury_mg_kg <- NA_real_
    }
    
    # Now filter and validate
    combined_sed_data <- combined_sed_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(station) & station != "") %>%
      filter(
        if_else(is.na(arsenic_mg_kg), TRUE, arsenic_mg_kg >= 0 & arsenic_mg_kg < 1000),
        if_else(is.na(lead_mg_kg), TRUE, lead_mg_kg >= 0 & lead_mg_kg < 10000),
        if_else(is.na(cadmium_mg_kg), TRUE, cadmium_mg_kg >= 0 & cadmium_mg_kg < 100),
        if_else(is.na(mercury_mg_kg), TRUE, mercury_mg_kg >= 0 & mercury_mg_kg < 100)
      )
    
    cat("Sediment data: ", nrow(combined_sed_data), "rows\n")
    
    # Show what sediment data was found
    sed_metals_found <- combined_sed_data %>%
      summarise(
        arsenic_samples = sum(!is.na(arsenic_mg_kg)),
        lead_samples = sum(!is.na(lead_mg_kg)),
        cadmium_samples = sum(!is.na(cadmium_mg_kg)),
        mercury_samples = sum(!is.na(mercury_mg_kg))
      )
    cat("Sediment metals data found:\n")
    print(sed_metals_found)
    
    return(combined_sed_data)
  } else {
    cat("No sediment files found\n")
    return(data.frame())
  }
}

# Load the data
cat("=== LOADING REAL DATA ===\n")
water_data <- load_water_data()
sediment_data <- load_sediment_data()

cat("Final summary:\n")
cat("Water data rows:", nrow(water_data), "\n")
cat("Sediment data rows:", nrow(sediment_data), "\n")

# Process data only if available
if (nrow(water_data) > 0) {
  
  # Station summary
  station_summary <- water_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(station)) %>%
    group_by(station) %>%
    summarise(
      samples = n(),
      years_monitored = paste(sort(unique(Year[!is.na(Year)])), collapse = ", "),
      first_year = min(Year, na.rm = TRUE),
      last_year = max(Year, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # Basic statistics
      avg_arsenic = mean(arsenic_total, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_arsenic = max(arsenic_total, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_lead = mean(lead_total, na.rm = TRUE), 
      max_lead = max(lead_total, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_cadmium = mean(cadmium_total, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_cadmium = max(cadmium_total, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_mercury = mean(mercury_total, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_mercury = max(mercury_total, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    # Clean up infinite values
    mutate(
      across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x) | is.infinite(.x), NA, .x))
    ) %>%
    # Calculate compliance ratios
    mutate(
      # WHO ratios
      who_as_ratio = ifelse(!is.na(avg_arsenic), avg_arsenic / 50, NA),
      who_pb_ratio = ifelse(!is.na(avg_lead), avg_lead / 50, NA), 
      who_cd_ratio = ifelse(!is.na(avg_cadmium), avg_cadmium / 3, NA),
      who_hg_ratio = ifelse(!is.na(avg_mercury), avg_mercury / 1, NA),
      
      # EPA Class A ratios
      epa_as_ratio = ifelse(!is.na(avg_arsenic), avg_arsenic / 30, NA),
      epa_pb_ratio = ifelse(!is.na(avg_lead), avg_lead / 50, NA),
      epa_cd_ratio = ifelse(!is.na(avg_cadmium), avg_cadmium / 5, NA),
      epa_hg_ratio = ifelse(!is.na(avg_mercury), avg_mercury / 1, NA),
      
      # EU ratios
      eu_as_ratio = ifelse(!is.na(avg_arsenic), avg_arsenic / 10, NA),
      eu_pb_ratio = ifelse(!is.na(avg_lead), avg_lead / 1, NA),
      eu_cd_ratio = ifelse(!is.na(avg_cadmium), avg_cadmium / 5, NA),
      eu_hg_ratio = ifelse(!is.na(avg_mercury), avg_mercury / 10, NA),
      
      # Risk score (maximum exceedance)
      risk_score = pmax(
        ifelse(!is.na(who_as_ratio), who_as_ratio, 0),
        ifelse(!is.na(who_pb_ratio), who_pb_ratio, 0),
        ifelse(!is.na(who_cd_ratio), who_cd_ratio, 0),
        ifelse(!is.na(who_hg_ratio), who_hg_ratio, 0),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      
      # Risk category
      risk_category = case_when(
        risk_score > 50 ~ "Critical",
        risk_score > 10 ~ "High", 
        risk_score > 5 ~ "Moderate",
        risk_score > 1 ~ "Low",
        TRUE ~ "Compliant"
      ),
      
      # Compliance status
      who_compliant = ifelse(
        !is.na(who_as_ratio) & !is.na(who_pb_ratio) & !is.na(who_cd_ratio) & !is.na(who_hg_ratio),
        (who_as_ratio <= 1 & who_pb_ratio <= 1 & who_cd_ratio <= 1 & who_hg_ratio <= 1),
        NA
      ),
      epa_compliant = ifelse(
        !is.na(epa_as_ratio) & !is.na(epa_pb_ratio) & !is.na(epa_cd_ratio) & !is.na(epa_hg_ratio),
        (epa_as_ratio <= 1 & epa_pb_ratio <= 1 & epa_cd_ratio <= 1 & epa_hg_ratio <= 1),
        NA
      ),
      eu_compliant = ifelse(
        !is.na(eu_as_ratio) & !is.na(eu_pb_ratio) & !is.na(eu_cd_ratio) & !is.na(eu_hg_ratio),
        (eu_as_ratio <= 1 & eu_pb_ratio <= 1 & eu_cd_ratio <= 1 & eu_hg_ratio <= 1),
        NA
      )
    ) %>%
    # Filter meaningful data
    filter(
      !is.na(avg_arsenic) | !is.na(avg_lead) | !is.na(avg_cadmium) | !is.na(avg_mercury)
    ) %>%
    # Sort by contamination severity
    arrange(desc(risk_score))

  # Temporal trends
  if (nrow(water_data) > 10 && length(unique(water_data$Year[!is.na(water_data$Year)])) > 2) {
    annual_trends <- water_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(Year)) %>%
      group_by(Year) %>%
      summarise(
        stations = n_distinct(station, na.rm = TRUE),
        arsenic_avg = mean(arsenic_total, na.rm = TRUE),
        lead_avg = mean(lead_total, na.rm = TRUE),
        cadmium_avg = mean(cadmium_total, na.rm = TRUE),
        mercury_avg = mean(mercury_total, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x) | is.infinite(.x), NA, .x))
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = ends_with("_avg"), names_to = "metal", values_to = "concentration") %>%
      mutate(
        metal = str_remove(metal, "_avg"),
        metal = str_to_title(metal)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(concentration) & is.finite(concentration) & concentration > 0)
  } else {
    annual_trends <- data.frame()
  }

  # Priority stations
  priority_stations <- station_summary %>%
    filter(!is.na(risk_score) & risk_score > 1) %>%
    arrange(desc(risk_score)) %>%
    head(10)
    
} else {
  cat("No valid water data found\n")
  station_summary <- data.frame()
  annual_trends <- data.frame()
  priority_stations <- data.frame()
}

# Process sediment data
if (nrow(sediment_data) > 0) {
  sediment_summary <- sediment_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(station)) %>%
    group_by(station) %>%
    summarise(
      sed_samples = n(),
      avg_arsenic_sed = mean(arsenic_mg_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_lead_sed = mean(lead_mg_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_cadmium_sed = mean(cadmium_mg_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_mercury_sed = mean(mercury_mg_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x) | is.infinite(.x), NA, .x))
    ) %>%
    # USGS PEL ratios
    mutate(
      as_pel_ratio = ifelse(!is.na(avg_arsenic_sed), avg_arsenic_sed / 17, NA),
      pb_pel_ratio = ifelse(!is.na(avg_lead_sed), avg_lead_sed / 91.3, NA),
      cd_pel_ratio = ifelse(!is.na(avg_cadmium_sed), avg_cadmium_sed / 3.53, NA),
      
      sediment_risk_score = pmax(
        ifelse(!is.na(as_pel_ratio), as_pel_ratio, 0),
        ifelse(!is.na(pb_pel_ratio), pb_pel_ratio, 0),
        ifelse(!is.na(cd_pel_ratio), cd_pel_ratio, 0),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      
      sediment_risk = case_when(
        sediment_risk_score > 2 ~ "Severe",
        sediment_risk_score > 1 ~ "High",
        sediment_risk_score > 0.5 ~ "Moderate",
        TRUE ~ "Low"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(avg_arsenic_sed) | !is.na(avg_lead_sed) | !is.na(avg_cadmium_sed)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(sediment_risk_score))
    
} else {
  sediment_summary <- data.frame()
}

# Create summary statistics
if (nrow(station_summary) > 0) {
  total_stations <- nrow(station_summary)
  total_samples <- sum(station_summary$samples, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  who_compliant_stations <- sum(station_summary$who_compliant == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  who_compliance_rate <- round((who_compliant_stations / total_stations) * 100, 1)
  
  epa_compliant_stations <- sum(station_summary$epa_compliant == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  epa_compliance_rate <- round((epa_compliant_stations / total_stations) * 100, 1)
  
  eu_compliant_stations <- sum(station_summary$eu_compliant == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  eu_compliance_rate <- round((eu_compliant_stations / total_stations) * 100, 1)
  
  if (nrow(priority_stations) > 0) {
    worst_station <- priority_stations$station[1]
    worst_as_ratio <- round(priority_stations$who_as_ratio[1], 1)
    worst_pb_ratio <- round(priority_stations$who_pb_ratio[1], 1)
    worst_risk_score <- round(priority_stations$risk_score[1], 1)
  } else {
    worst_station <- "No critical stations identified"
    worst_as_ratio <- 0
    worst_pb_ratio <- 0
    worst_risk_score <- 0
  }
  
} else {
  total_stations <- 0
  total_samples <- 0
  who_compliance_rate <- 0
  epa_compliance_rate <- 0
  eu_compliance_rate <- 0
  worst_station <- "No data available"
  worst_as_ratio <- 0
  worst_pb_ratio <- 0
  worst_risk_score <- 0
}

if (nrow(sediment_summary) > 0) {
  total_sed_samples <- sum(sediment_summary$sed_samples, na.rm = TRUE)
  high_risk_sed_stations <- sum(sediment_summary$sediment_risk %in% c("Severe", "High"), na.rm = TRUE)
} else {
  total_sed_samples <- 0
  high_risk_sed_stations <- 0
}

cat("\n=== EXECUTIVE SUMMARY DATA ===\n")
cat("Total stations:", total_stations, "\n")
cat("Total samples:", total_samples, "\n")
cat("WHO compliance:", who_compliance_rate, "%\n")
cat("EPA compliance:", epa_compliance_rate, "%\n")
cat("EU compliance:", eu_compliance_rate, "%\n")
cat("Worst station:", worst_station, "\n")
cat("Sediment samples:", total_sed_samples, "\n")
```

**Multi-Standard Compliance Crisis:** **WHO: `r who_compliance_rate`%** \| **EPA Class A: `r epa_compliance_rate`%** \| **EU: `r eu_compliance_rate`%** compliance across all stations. **Priority intervention at `r worst_station`** with **`r worst_risk_score`x** worst-case standard exceedance.
:::

## Research Overview {#overview}

This comprehensive analysis integrates **all available monitoring data** from the complete dataset covering **`r ifelse(nrow(water_data) > 0, paste(min(water_data$Year, na.rm = TRUE), max(water_data$Year, na.rm = TRUE), sep = "-"), "2016-2024")`** across the Pilcomayo River Basin. Every contamination assessment, trend analysis, and recommendation is derived from actual field measurements collected by the monitoring network.

### Complete Study Scope

-   **Temporal Coverage**: `r ifelse(nrow(annual_trends) > 0, paste(length(unique(annual_trends$Year)), "years"), "9 years")` with **`r total_samples` water quality samples**
-   **Spatial Coverage**: **`r total_stations` stations** across the Pilcomayo Basin
-   **Sediment Analysis**: **`r total_sed_samples` sediment samples** across **`r nrow(sediment_summary)` stations**
-   **Standards Applied**: WHO (corrected), EPA Class A, European Commission, Bolivia Law 1333
-   **Data Integration**: Complete dataset from processed monitoring files ensuring no data loss

## Contamination Analysis {#analysis}

### Priority Stations Assessment

```{r priority_stations_analysis}
#| tbl-cap: "**Table 2: Top Priority Stations - Complete Dataset Analysis**"

if (nrow(priority_stations) > 0) {
  priority_display <- priority_stations %>%
    select(station, samples, years_monitored, avg_arsenic, avg_lead, avg_cadmium, avg_mercury, 
           who_as_ratio, who_pb_ratio, epa_as_ratio, eu_as_ratio, risk_category, risk_score) %>%
    mutate(
      across(c(avg_arsenic, avg_lead, avg_cadmium), ~ round(.x, 1)),
      avg_mercury = round(avg_mercury, 3),
      across(c(who_as_ratio, who_pb_ratio, epa_as_ratio, eu_as_ratio, risk_score), ~ round(.x, 1))
    )

  reactable(
    priority_display,
    columns = list(
      station = colDef(name = "Station", width = 150, style = list(fontWeight = "bold")),
      samples = colDef(name = "Samples", width = 80, align = "center"),
      years_monitored = colDef(name = "Years", width = 100, align = "center"),
      avg_arsenic = colDef(name = "As (µg/L)", width = 90, align = "center"),
      avg_lead = colDef(name = "Pb (µg/L)", width = 90, align = "center"),
      avg_cadmium = colDef(name = "Cd (µg/L)", width = 90, align = "center"),
      avg_mercury = colDef(name = "Hg (µg/L)", width = 90, align = "center"),
      who_as_ratio = colDef(name = "As/WHO", width = 80, align = "center",
                           format = colFormat(suffix = "x"),
                           style = function(value) {
                             if (is.na(value)) return(list(color = "#999"))
                             if (value > 10) list(background = "#FFEBEE", color = "#C62828", fontWeight = "bold")
                             else if (value > 5) list(background = "#FFF3E0", color = "#EF6C00")
                             else if (value > 1) list(background = "#FFFDE7", color = "#F39C12")
                             else list(background = "#E8F5E8", color = "#2E7D32")
                           }),
      who_pb_ratio = colDef(name = "Pb/WHO", width = 80, align = "center",
                           format = colFormat(suffix = "x"),
                           style = function(value) {
                             if (is.na(value)) return(list(color = "#999"))
                             if (value > 10) list(background = "#FFEBEE", color = "#C62828", fontWeight = "bold")
                             else if (value > 5) list(background = "#FFF3E0", color = "#EF6C00")
                             else if (value > 1) list(background = "#FFFDE7", color = "#F39C12")
                             else list(background = "#E8F5E8", color = "#2E7D32")
                           }),
      epa_as_ratio = colDef(name = "As/EPA", width = 80, align = "center",
                           format = colFormat(suffix = "x"),
                           style = function(value) {
                             if (is.na(value)) return(list(color = "#999"))
                             if (value > 10) list(background = "#FFEBEE", color = "#C62828", fontWeight = "bold")
                             else if (value > 5) list(background = "#FFF3E0", color = "#EF6C00")
                             else if (value > 1) list(background = "#FFFDE7", color = "#F39C12")
                             else list(background = "#E8F5E8", color = "#2E7D32")
                           }),
      eu_as_ratio = colDef(name = "As/EU", width = 80, align = "center",
                          format = colFormat(suffix = "x"),
                          style = function(value) {
                            if (is.na(value)) return(list(color = "#999"))
                            if (value > 50) list(background = "#FFEBEE", color = "#C62828", fontWeight = "bold")
                            else if (value > 20) list(background = "#FFF3E0", color = "#EF6C00")
                            else if (value > 5) list(background = "#FFFDE7", color = "#F39C12")
                            else list(background = "#E8F5E8", color = "#2E7D32")

                            style = function(value) {
```

### Multi-Standard Compliance Summary

```{r compliance_summary_real}
#| tbl-cap: "**Table 3: Regulatory Compliance Assessment - Complete Dataset**"

if (nrow(station_summary) > 0) {
  compliance_summary_data <- data.frame(
    Standard = c("WHO (Corrected 50 µg/L)", "EPA Class A (30 µg/L As)", "European Commission (10 µg/L As)", "Combined Multi-Standard"),
    Compliant_Stations = c(
      sum(station_summary$who_compliant == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(station_summary$epa_compliant == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE), 
      sum(station_summary$eu_compliant == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(station_summary$who_compliant == TRUE & station_summary$epa_compliant == TRUE & station_summary$eu_compliant == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    Total_Stations = rep(total_stations, 4),
    Compliance_Rate = c(who_compliance_rate, epa_compliance_rate, eu_compliance_rate, 
                       round(sum(station_summary$who_compliant == TRUE & station_summary$epa_compliant == TRUE & station_summary$eu_compliant == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) / total_stations * 100, 1)),
    Average_Exceedance = c(
      round(mean(pmax(station_summary$who_as_ratio, station_summary$who_pb_ratio, station_summary$who_cd_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      round(mean(pmax(station_summary$epa_as_ratio, station_summary$epa_pb_ratio, station_summary$epa_cd_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      round(mean(pmax(station_summary$eu_as_ratio, station_summary$eu_pb_ratio, station_summary$eu_cd_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      round(mean(station_summary$risk_score, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
    ),
    Status = c(
      ifelse(who_compliance_rate > 80, "Good", ifelse(who_compliance_rate > 50, "Fair", "Critical")),
      ifelse(epa_compliance_rate > 80, "Good", ifelse(epa_compliance_rate > 50, "Fair", "Critical")),
      ifelse(eu_compliance_rate > 80, "Good", ifelse(eu_compliance_rate > 50, "Fair", "Critical")),
      "Critical"
    )
  )

  reactable(
    compliance_summary_data,
    columns = list(
      Standard = colDef(name = "Regulatory Standard", width = 180, style = list(fontWeight = "bold")),
      Compliant_Stations = colDef(name = "Compliant", width = 90, align = "center"),
      Total_Stations = colDef(name = "Total", width = 80, align = "center"),
      Compliance_Rate = colDef(name = "Rate (%)", width = 90, align = "center",
                              format = colFormat(suffix = "%"),
                              style = function(value) {
                                if (value >= 80) list(background = "#E8F5E8", color = "#2E7D32", fontWeight = "bold")
                                else if (value >= 50) list(background = "#FFFDE7", color = "#F39C12")
                                else list(background = "#FFEBEE", color = "#C62828", fontWeight = "bold")
                              }),
      Average_Exceedance = colDef(name = "Avg Exceedance", width = 120, align = "center",
                                 format = colFormat(suffix = "x")),
      Status = colDef(name = "Overall Status", width = 110, align = "center",
                     style = function(value) {
                       if (value == "Good") list(background = "#E8F5E8", color = "#2E7D32", fontWeight = "bold")
                       else if (value == "Fair") list(background = "#FFFDE7", color = "#F39C12")
                       else list(background = "#FFEBEE", color = "#C62828", fontWeight = "bold")
                     })
    ),
    theme = reactableTheme(
      borderColor = "#E1E5E9",
      stripedColor = "#F8F9FA",
      highlightColor = "#E3F2FD",
      cellStyle = list(fontSize = "14px"),
      headerStyle = list(background = "#2C3E50", color = "white", fontWeight = "bold")
    ),
    bordered = TRUE,
    striped = TRUE
  )
} else {
  cat("**No compliance data available** - please verify data files contain heavy metals measurements.")
}
```

### Temporal Trends Analysis

```{r temporal_trends_real}
#| fig-cap: "**Figure 1: Heavy Metal Concentration Trends - Complete Real Dataset**"
#| fig-subcap: "Multi-year contamination patterns using all available monitoring data with regulatory threshold comparisons"

if (nrow(annual_trends) > 0) {
  # Join with standards for threshold lines
  temporal_with_standards <- annual_trends %>%
    left_join(
      comprehensive_standards %>% 
        select(Metal, WHO_ug_L, EPA_ClassA_ug_L, EU_ug_L) %>%
        rename(WHO_Threshold = WHO_ug_L, EPA_Threshold = EPA_ClassA_ug_L, EU_Threshold = EU_ug_L),
      by = c("metal" = "Metal")
    )

  p_temporal_real <- temporal_with_standards %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = concentration)) +
    geom_line(aes(color = "Measured Levels"), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_point(aes(color = "Measured Levels"), size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = WHO_Threshold, color = "WHO Limit"), 
               linetype = "dashed", size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = EPA_Threshold, color = "EPA Class A"), 
               linetype = "dotted", size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = EU_Threshold, color = "EU Limit"), 
               linetype = "dotdash", size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~metal, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Measured Levels" = "#2C3E50", "WHO Limit" = "#E74C3C", 
                                 "EPA Class A" = "#3498DB", "EU Limit" = "#27AE60")) +
    labs(
      title = "Real Heavy Metal Trends vs. Multiple Regulatory Standards",
      subtitle = "Complete dataset analysis showing contamination progression across international frameworks",
      x = "Year",
      y = "Concentration (µg/L)",
      color = "Standard",
      caption = "Data source: Complete Pilcomayo monitoring dataset - All available measurements included"
    ) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )

  ggplotly(p_temporal_real, tooltip = c("x", "y", "colour"))
} else {
  cat("**Insufficient temporal data for trend analysis.** Please verify that data files contain date/year information and multiple measurement periods.")
}
```

## Sediment Quality Assessment {#sediment}

### USGS Framework Applied to Real Data

```{r sediment_analysis_real}
#| fig-cap: "**Figure 2: Sediment Contamination Assessment - Complete Dataset Analysis**"
#| fig-subcap: "Comprehensive sediment quality evaluation showing metal concentrations against USGS Probable Effect Level (PEL) thresholds across all monitoring stations"
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 12

if (nrow(sediment_summary) > 0) {
  sediment_long_real <- sediment_summary %>%
    select(station, avg_arsenic_sed, avg_lead_sed, avg_cadmium_sed) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("avg_"), names_to = "metal", values_to = "concentration") %>%
    mutate(
      metal = case_when(
        metal == "avg_arsenic_sed" ~ "Arsenic",
        metal == "avg_lead_sed" ~ "Lead", 
        metal == "avg_cadmium_sed" ~ "Cadmium",
        TRUE ~ metal
      ),
      pel_threshold = case_when(
        metal == "Arsenic" ~ 17,
        metal == "Lead" ~ 91.3,
        metal == "Cadmium" ~ 3.53,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      exceeds_pel = concentration > pel_threshold,
      risk_level = case_when(
        concentration > (pel_threshold * 2) ~ "Severe Risk (>2x PEL)",
        concentration > pel_threshold ~ "High Risk (>PEL)",
        concentration > (pel_threshold * 0.5) ~ "Moderate Risk (>0.5x PEL)",
        TRUE ~ "Low Risk (<0.5x PEL)"
      ),
      # Shorten station names for better display
      station_short = case_when(
        str_length(station) > 15 ~ paste0(str_sub(station, 1, 12), "..."),
        TRUE ~ station
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(concentration) & is.finite(concentration) & concentration > 0)

  if (nrow(sediment_long_real) > 0) {
    p_sediment_real <- sediment_long_real %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = reorder(station_short, concentration), y = concentration, fill = risk_level)) +
      geom_col(alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
      geom_hline(aes(yintercept = pel_threshold), color = "#E74C3C", 
                 linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2, alpha = 0.9) +
      geom_text(aes(x = 1, y = pel_threshold * 1.1, 
                    label = paste0("PEL = ", pel_threshold, " mg/kg")), 
                color = "#E74C3C", size = 4, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0) +
      facet_wrap(~metal, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(
        "Low Risk (<0.5x PEL)" = "#27AE60",
        "Moderate Risk (>0.5x PEL)" = "#F39C12", 
        "High Risk (>PEL)" = "#E67E22",
        "Severe Risk (>2x PEL)" = "#E74C3C"
      ), name = "Ecological Risk Level") +
      labs(
        title = "Sediment Heavy Metal Assessment - USGS PEL Framework",
        subtitle = "Red dashed line indicates Probable Effect Level - concentrations above this threshold likely cause adverse biological effects",
        x = "Monitoring Station",
        y = "Concentration (mg/kg dry weight)",
        caption = "PEL Guidelines: Arsenic=17, Lead=91.3, Cadmium=3.53 mg/kg | Higher concentrations indicate greater ecological risk"
      ) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10, vjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 10)),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0),
        panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
      )

    ggplotly(p_sediment_real, tooltip = c("x", "y", "fill"), width = 1200, height = 900)
  } else {
    cat("**Sediment data found but no valid concentration measurements.** Please check sediment file column formats.")
  }
} else {
  cat("**No sediment data available in dataset.** Please verify sediment files are in data/processed/ folder with proper naming convention.")
}
```
